# One tree's share of the secret-scan allow-list:
#
#     path | rule-id | sha256 fingerprint | reason
#
# The format, what an entry may say, and why this is a directory rather than a
# file are argued once in README.md beside this file. Do not restate them here.
#
# covers: deploy/


# Section 14.1's local development defaults.
#
# CLAUDE.md names this exception outright and argues it: the compose defaults
# are what make a first `docker compose up` work with no prior setup, and the
# environment variable in front of each is the seam that keeps them out of
# anything deployed. docs/secrets.md tabulates the same four.
#
# THE SEAM IS AGAINST DEPLOYING THE VALUE, NOT AGAINST WRITING IT DOWN, which
# is why these are entries here rather than a shape the patterns skip. Every
# site the local database default is written appears in this directory, and
# that is the useful half: rotating it is then a reconciliation these files
# enumerate, which is the one rule this repository has.
#
# Section 14.1's model is an index and one file per deployable unit, so a
# service's defaults are entries against that service's own path. Two
# services' entries still land in this one file: `covers:` names a tree, and
# `deploy/` is one tree.

deploy/compose/.env.example | env-assignment | 8a11e54d9d5b | Section 14.1's local database default, the override sample.
deploy/compose/.env.example | connection-string-password | 8a11e54d9d5b | The same default inside the commented per-service overrides.
deploy/compose/infrastructure.yml | credential-assignment | 8a11e54d9d5b | Section 14.1's local database default on the server container.
deploy/compose/services/catalog.yml | connection-string-password | 8a11e54d9d5b | The same default, nested inside Catalog's two connection defaults.
deploy/compose/services/catalog.yml | credential-assignment | 745769414f29 | Catalog's local connection default, in-cluster hostname.
deploy/compose/services/catalog.yml | credential-assignment | 67c0aed2aa92 | Section 14.1's broker default for Catalog, the per-service account that replaced guest.
deploy/compose/services/catalog.yml | connection-string-password | 598ba19368bd | Section 14.1's local Redis default for Catalog's own ACL user, on both instances.
deploy/compose/services/catalog.yml | credential-assignment | ceeb7732aeb5 | Catalog's local Redis cache default, under its own ACL user.
deploy/compose/services/catalog.yml | credential-assignment | 7cf80b36e15a | Catalog's local Redis coordination default, the same ACL user.
